# nexus

Manage Nexus hosts

nexus manages containers, packages and scripts on hosts running nexusd.
Commands take the form: nexus <noun> <verb> [args]
`nexus command get` lists them; `nexus help <noun> <verb>` shows one's usage and examples.

## Usage

```
nexus [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help          help for nexus
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
  -v, --version       version for nexus
```
